def run_main():
    log("=== Model 3: Celebrity-Covariate Impact Model ===")
    con, wk, pan = load_shared()
    log(f"[load] contestants {len(con)} rows, weekly {len(wk)} rows, panel {len(pan)} rows")

    # ---- weekly features -------------------------------------------------------
    wk = wk.sort_values(["season", "week", "row_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    wk["zS"] = wk.groupby(["season", "week"])["week_score_mean"].transform(
        lambda x: (x - x.mean()) / (x.std(ddof=0) if x.std(ddof=0) > 0 else 1.0))
    m = wk["week_score_mean"].sum()
    wk["cum01"] = wk.groupby(["season", "celebrity_name"])["week_score_mean"].cumsum() / m
    # pre_week = first danced week of that season
    fw = wk.groupby(["season", "celebrity_name"])["week"].min().rename("pre_week")
    wk = wk.merge(fw, left_on=["season", "celebrity_name"], right_index=True, how="left")
    # n_competitors_season (max n_competitors in the season, incl. wk 1 replacements)
    ncomp = pan.groupby("season")["n_competitors"].max().rename("n_comp")
    con = con.merge(ncomp, left_on="season", right_index=True, how="left")
    wk = wk.merge(ncomp, left_on="season", right_index=True, how="left")
    wk["age"] = con.set_index(["celebrity_name", "season"])["celebrity_age_during_season"].reindex(
        pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays([wk["celebrity_name"], wk["season"]])).to_numpy()
    assert not wk["age"].isna().any(), "join leakage on age"

    # ---- fan-vote inversion ----------------------------------------------------
    phi_hat, var_phi, lo90, hi90, elim = invert_fanvotes(wk, pan)
    wk["elim"] = elim
    wk["phi_hat"], wk["var_phi"], wk["phi_lo90"], wk["phi_hi90"] = phi_hat, var_phi, lo90, hi90
    # adopt Model 1's phi if available (parallel-run fail-switch)
    phi_hat, var_phi, m1info = check_m1_and_apply(wk, phi_hat, var_phi)
    wk["phi_hat"] = phi_hat
    wk["var_phi"] = var_phi
    wk["phi_tilde"] = np.clip(np.log(wk["phi_hat"] / (1 - wk["phi_hat"])), -15, 15)

    # ---- covariate table -------------------------------------------------------
    top_partners = build_covariate_dicts(con, wk)
    con["ind_g"] = con["celebrity_industry"].map(industry_group)
    con["home_g"] = con["celebrity_homecountry_region"].map(home_group)
    cmap = con.set_index(["celebrity_name", "season"])
    wk = wk.merge(cmap[["ind_g", "home_g"]], left_on=["celebrity_name", "season"],
                  right_index=True, how="left")
    assert not wk["ind_g"].isna().any()
    wk["age_cs"] = (wk["age"] - AGE_CENTER) / AGE_SCALE
    partner = wk["ballroom_partner"].where(wk["ballroom_partner"].isin(top_partners), "Other")
    wk["p_g"] = partner
    ind_d = pd.get_dummies(wk["ind_g"], prefix="ind", drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    home_d = pd.get_dummies(wk["home_g"], prefix="home", drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    part_d = pd.get_dummies(wk["p_g"], prefix="pro", drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    season_d = pd.get_dummies(wk["season"], prefix="season", drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    week_d = pd.get_dummies(wk["week"], prefix="week", drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    wk = pd.concat([wk.reset_index(drop=True), ind_d.reset_index(drop=True),
                    home_d.reset_index(drop=True), part_d.reset_index(drop=True),
                    season_d.reset_index(drop=True), week_d.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    trait_cols = ["age_cs"] + list(ind_d.columns) + list(home_d.columns)
    season_cols_full = list(season_d.columns)
    struct_cols = list(week_d.columns) + ["cum01"]
    C_traits = trait_cols
    C_struct = season_cols_full + struct_cols

    # partner effect in a separate spec (only added to a reduced-structure model)
    trait_cols_p = ["age_cs"] + list(ind_d.columns) + list(home_d.columns) + list(part_d.columns)
    C_struct_p = season_cols_full + struct_cols

    # ================= D1: judges' channel =====================================
    log("[D1] MixedLM (REML) on weekly judge score S_iw ...")
    exog1 = ["const"] + trait_cols + C_struct
    md1, r1, conv1, n1, grp1 = d1_mixedlm(wk, C_traits + C_struct)
    fe1 = r1.fe_params
    log(f"[D1] converged={conv1}, nobs={int(r1.nobs)}, groups={md1.k_groups}, "
        f"var_random={r1.cov_re.iloc[0, 0] if hasattr(r1.cov_re, 'iloc') else r1.cov_re[0, 0]:.4f}, "
        f"resid_var={r1.scale:.4f}, ICC="
        f"{(r1.cov_re.iloc[0, 0] if hasattr(r1.cov_re, 'iloc') else r1.cov_re[0,0]) / ((r1.cov_re.iloc[0,0] if hasattr(r1.cov_re, 'iloc') else r1.cov_re[0,0]) + r1.scale):.3f}")
    log("[D1] key coefficients: " + ", ".join(
        [f"{k}={v:.3f}" for k, v in fe1.items() if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete",
         "ind_Singer", "ind_Reality_Star", "ind_Host", "ind_Singer_Songwriter",
         "ind_Actor_Actress", "home_UK_Ireland", "home_East_SE_Asia", "cum01"]]))
    pred_S = md1.predict(sm.add_constant(wk[C_traits + C_struct].astype(float),
                                         has_constant="add")).reshape(-1)
    wk["S_hat"] = pred_S
    pr2_ind = partialR2_wald(r1, [c for c in trait_cols if c.startswith("ind_")])
    pr2_part = partialR2_wald(r1, [c for c in trait_cols_p if c.startswith("pro_")])
    log(f"[D1] partial R2 (Wald proxy): industry={pr2_ind[0]:.4f} (p={pr2_ind[1]:.3g}), "
        f"partner={pr2_part[0]:.4f} (p={pr2_part[1]:.3g})")
    # AR(1) LRT
    md1a, r1a, conv1a = d1_ar1_mixedlm(wk, C_traits + C_struct, grp1)
    lrt_stat = 2 * (r1a.llf - r1.llf)
    lrt_p = float(st.chi2.sf(lrt_stat, 1))
    log(f"[D1] AR(1) converged={conv1a}, llf={r1a.llf:.2f} vs {r1.llf:.2f}, "
        f"LRT p={lrt_p:.3g} (adopt if p<0.01)")
    r_model = r1
    r_ar_notes = "AR(1) NOT adopted (parsimony rule p>=0.01)" if lrt_p >= 0.01 else "AR(1) adopted"
    if conv1a and lrt_p < 0.01:
        r_model = r1a
    # age on judges channel
    age_b = fe1["age_cs"]
    age_p = float(r1.pvalues["age_cs"])
    log(f"[D1] age (per +13.3y) effect on judge score: {age_b * AGE_SCALE:+.3f} "
        f"points (p={age_p:.3g})")

    # ================= D2: fans' channel =======================================
    log("[D2] weighted Binomial GEE on logit(phi_tilde) ...")
    s2 = wk["var_phi"].to_numpy(float)
    s2 = np.clip(s2, 1e-6, None)
    w_obs = 1.0 / s2
    w_obs = w_obs * len(w_obs) / w_obs.sum()   # normalized weights
    exog2 = C_traits + C_struct
    gee, glm, n2, Yphi = d2_fan_gee(wk, exog2, w_obs)
    wk["phi_tilde_hat"] = gee.predict(sm.add_constant(wk[exog2].astype(float),
                                                      has_constant="add"))
    fe2 = pd.Series(gee.params, index=n2)
    log(f"[D2] GEE dep={gee.cov_struct.dep:.3f}; phiTraj corr within-couple; "
        f"weights mean={w_obs.mean():.3f}, p10={np.quantile(w_obs, .1):.3f}, "
        f"p90={np.quantile(w_obs, .9):.3f}")
    pr2_ind_f = partialR2_wald(gee, [c for c in trait_cols if c.startswith("ind_")])
    log("[D2] key coefficients (log-odds): " + ", ".join(
        [f"{k}={v:+.3f}" for k, v in fe2.items() if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete",
         "ind_Singer", "ind_Reality_Star", "ind_Host", "ind_Singer_Songwriter",
         "ind_Actor_Actress", "home_UK_Ireland", "home_East_SE_Asia"]]))
    phi_age_b = fe2["age_cs"]
    phi_age_p = float(gee.pvalues["age_cs"]) if hasattr(gee, "pvalues") else np.nan
    log(f"[D2] age effect on logit(phi): {phi_age_b:+.3f} per +13.3y (p={phi_age_p:.3g})")

    # ================= D3: differential =========================================
    log("[D3] over/under-rating residual regression ...")
    ols3, R3, okR, zs, zp = d3_diff(wk, C_traits + C_struct)
    wk["R"] = R3
    fe3 = pd.Series(ols3.params, index=ols3.params.index)
    log("[D3] key coefficients (z-units): " + ", ".join(
        [f"{k}={v:+.3f}" for k, v in ols3.params.items()
         if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete", "ind_Singer", "ind_Reality_Star",
                  "ind_Host", "home_UK_Ireland", "home_East_SE_Asia"]]))
    r3_age = ols3.params["age_cs"]
    r3_age_p = ols3.pvalues["age_cs"]
    # sanity anchor: young social-media stars raw profile
    if (wk["ind_g"] == "Social Media Personality").sum() > 0:
        smp = wk[wk["ind_g Alaska" if False else "ind_g"] == "Social Media Personality"]
        log(f"[sanity] Social Media Personality raw: n_weeks={len(smp)}, "
            f"mean S={smp['S'].mean():.2f}, mean phi={smp['phi_hat'].mean():.3f}, "
            f"mean R={smp['R'].mean():+.3f}")
    else:
        log("[sanity] no Social Media Personality rows")
    young = wk[wk["age"] <= 22]
    log(f"[sanity] young (<=22) raw: n_weeks={len(young)}, mean S={young['S'].mean():.2f}, "
        f"mean phi={young['phi_hat'].mean():.3f}, mean R={young['R'].mean():+.3f}")
    young_smp = young[young["ind_g"] == "Social Media Personality"]
    if len(young_smp) > 0:
        log(f"[sanity] young-SMP: n={len(young_smp)}, mean S={young_smp['S'].mean():.2f}, "
            f"mean phi={young_smp['phi_hat'].mean():.3f}, mean R={young_smp['R'].mean():+.3f}")

    # ================= D4: survival =============================================
    log("[D4] Breslow PHReg with strata (season, week) ...")
    judge_feats = ["zS", "cum01"]
    fan_feats = ["phi_hat_std"]
    wk["phi_hat_std"] = (wk["phi_hat"] - wk["phi_hat"].mean()) / wk["phi_hat"].std(ddof=0)
    # step 1: everything except phi
    cols_step1 = judge_feats + trait_cols
    m41, r41, _, cols41, str4 = d4_survival(wk, cols_step1)
    lp41 = np.asarray(Xfor := wk[cols_step1].astype(float).sum(axis=1) + r41.params["const"], float)
    lp41 = (sm.add_constant(wk[cols_step1].astype(float), has_constant="add") * r41.params).sum(axis=1).to_numpy()
    conc1 = cox_concordance(wk["week"].to_numpy(float) - wk["pre_week"].to_numpy(float),
                            wk["elim"].to_numpy(float), str4, lp41)
    # step 2: judges' features + traits + phi
    cols_step2 = judge_feats + fan_feats + trait_cols
    m42, r42, _, cols42, str42 = d4_survival(wk, cols_step2)
    lp42 = (sm.add_constant(wk[cols_step2].astype(float), has_constant="add") * r42.params).sum(axis=1).to_numpy()
    conc2 = cox_concordance(wk["week"].to_numpy(float) - wk["pre_week"].to_numpy(float),
                            wk["elim"].to_numpy(float), str42, lp42)
    b_zS_1 = r41.params["zS"]
    b_zS_2 = r42.params["zS"]
    b_phi_2 = r42.params["phi_hat_std"]
    log(f"[D4] concordance: step1={conc1:.3f}, step2(+phi_hat)={conc2:.3f}; "
        f"b_zS: {b_zS_1:+.3f} -> {b_zS_2:+.3f} after phi; b_phi={b_phi_2:+.3f} "
        f"(p={r42.pvalues['phi_hat_std']:.3g})")
    # sanity: zS slope must be negative (good judges -> longer survival)
    assert b_zS_2 < 0, "zS slope must be negative"
    # withdrawn exclusion robustness
    mask_no_wd = wk["status"] != "withdrew"
    m5w, r5w, _, _, _ = d4_survival(wk[mask_no_wd], cols_step2)
    log(f"[D4] refit without withdrawn: b_zS={r5w.params['zS']:+.3f}, "
        f"b_phi={r5w.params['phi_hat_std']:+.3f}")
    # final-duty logit (dance-off proxy)
    duty = ((pan if False else wk)["season"] >= 28).to_numpy()
    Xduty = sm.add_constant(wk.loc[duty, ["phi_hat_std"]].assign(cum01=wk.loc[duty, "cum01"]),
                            has_constant="add")
    yduty = wk.loc[duty, "final_duty"].to_numpy(float)
    r_duty = sm.GLM(yduty, Xduty, family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit()
    log(f"[D4] final-duty logit (S28+): b_phi={r_duty.params['phi_hat_std']:+.3f}, "
        f"AUC={hazard_auc(wk.loc[duty].assign(elim=yduty), -Xduty['phi_hat_std'].to_numpy()):.3f}, "
        f"n_pos={int(yduty.sum())}/{int(len(yduty))}")

    # ================= validation: held-out seasons =============================
    log("[validation] 27-train / 7-test season split ...")
    all_seasons = np.array(sorted(wk["season"].unique()))
    rng.shuffle(all_seasons)
    test_s = np.sort(all_seasons[:7])
    train_s = np.sort(all_seasons[7:])
    tr, te = wk["season"].isin(train_s), wk["season"].isin(test_s)
    # D1 on train, predict test
    mdt = sm.MixedLM(wk.loc[tr, "S"].to_numpy(float),
                     sm.add_constant(wk.loc[tr, C_traits + C_struct].astype(float),
                                     has_constant="add"),
                     groups=pd.factorize(wk.loc[tr, "celebrity_name"].astype(str) + "_"
                                         + wk.loc[tr, "season"].astype(str))[0])
    rt = mdt.fit(reml=True, method="lbfgs", maxiter=500)
    Xt = sm.add_constant(wk.loc[te, C_traits + C_struct].astype(float), has_constant="add")
    pred_te = np.asarray(mdt.predict(Xt, cast_to=float) if False else mdt.predict(Xt), float).reshape(-1)
    yte = wk.loc[te, "S"].to_numpy(float)
    ss_res = ((yte - pred_te) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot = ((yte - yte.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    r2_judges = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    # D2 on train, predict test (phi_hat target from Model 1 or fallback)
    mt = sm.GLM(np.clip(wk.loc[tr, "phi_hat"].to_numpy(float), 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4),
                sm.add_constant(wk.loc[tr, exog2].astype(float), has_constant="add"),
                family=sm.families.Binomial(),
                freq_weights=w_obs[tr.to_numpy()]).fit()
    pred_te_phi = mt.predict(sm.add_constant(wk.loc[te, exog2].astype(float),
                                             has_constant="add")).to_numpy()
    spear_fan = st.spearmanr(wk.loc[te, "phi_hat"], pred_te_phi).statistic
    # survival AUC on test
    ms = sm.PHReg(wk.loc[tr, "week"].to_numpy(float) - wk.loc[tr, "pre_week"].to_numpy(float),
                  sm.add_constant(wk.loc[tr, cols_step2].astype(float), has_constant="add"),
                  status=wk.loc[tr, "elim"].to_numpy(float),
                  strata=(wk.loc[tr, "season"].astype(str) + "|"
                          + wk.loc[tr, "week"].astype(str)).to_numpy(), ties="breslow")
    rs = ms.fit()
    lp_te = (sm.add_constant(wk.loc[te, cols_step2].astype(float), has_constant="add")
             * rs.params).sum(axis=1).to_numpy()
    auc_surv = hazard_auc(wk.loc[te].copy(), -lp_te)
    log(f"[validation] out-of-sample (7 test seasons): R2_judges={r2_judges:.3f}, "
        f"spearman_fans={spear_fan:.3f}, survival_AUC={auc_surv:.3f}")

    # ================= robustness: leave-one-industry-out =======================
    log("[robustness] leave-one-industry-out on D1 age & D2 age ...")
    inds = [c.replace("ind_", "").replace("_", " ") for c in ind_d.columns]
    sign_store = {}
    for g in inds:
        if g == "Other":
            continue
        keep = wk["ind_g"] != g
        Xs = sm.add_constant(wk.loc[keep, C_traits + C_struct].astype(float), has_constant="add")
        rs1 = sm.MixedLM(wk.loc[keep, "S"].to_numpy(float), Xs,
                         groups=pd.factorize(wk.loc[keep, "celebrity_name"].astype(str) + "_"
                                             + wk.loc[keep, "season"].astype(str))[0]).fit(reml=True, method="lbfgs")
        sf = 1.0 / s2[keep.to_numpy()]
        sf = sf / sf.sum()
        rs2 = sm.GLM(np.clip(wk.loc[keep, "phi_hat"], 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4), Xs,
                     family=sm.families.Binomial(), freq_weights=sf).fit()
        sign_store[g] = (float(rs1.params["age_cs"]), float(rs1.pvalues["age_cs"]),
                         float(rs2.params["age_cs"]))
    flipped = sum(1 for g, (bb, pp, bb2) in sign_store.items()
                  if np.sign(bb) != np.sign(age_b) or np.sign(bb2) != np.sign(phi_age_b))
    log(f"[robustness] {len(sign_store)} LOIO refits; age-effect sign flips: "
        f"{flipped} ({flipped / max(len(sign_store), 1):.0%}) out of "
        f"{len(sign_store) * 2} channel tests (target <10%)")

    # ================= archetype survival curves ================================
    log("[archetypes] counterfactual casting predictions ...")
    archetypes = [
        ("17yo Social Media Star", 17, "Social media personality", "Witney Carson", "US"),
        ("20yo Disney Actress", 20, "Actor/Actress", "Mark Ballas", "US"),
        ("27yo Olympic Gymnast", 27, "Athlete", "Witney Carson", "US"),
        ("29yo Pop Singer", 29, "Singer", "Artem Chigvintsev", "US"),
        ("31yo Reality Star", 31, "Reality Star", "Artem Chigvintsev", "US"),
        ("35yo Pro Athlete", 35, "Athlete", "Val Chmerkovskiy", "US"),
        ("50yo Actor (UK)", 50, "Actor/Actress", "Anton Du Beke", "UK-Ireland"),
        ("73yo Talk-Show Host", 73, "Host", "Tony Dovolani", "US"),
    ]
    # rebuild prediction exog for a hypothetical week-3 row of every (archetype, season)
    def trait_vec(age, ind, homeg):
        ig = industry_group(ind)
        hg = home_group(homeg)
        row = {"age_cs": (age - AGE_CENTER) / AGE_SCALE}
        for c in ind_d.columns:
            v = c.replace("ind_", "").replace("_", " ")
            row[c] = 1.0 if v == ig else 0.0
        for c in home_d.columns:
            v = c.replace("home_", "").replace("_", "-")
            hm = c.replace("home_", "").replace("_", " ")
            norm = {"East_SE_Asia": "East-SE-Asia", "UK_Ireland": "UK-Ireland"}
            v2 = norm.get(c.replace("home_", ""), "Other-Intl" if c == "home_Other_Intl" else c.replace("home_", ""))
            row[c] = 1.0 if v2 == hg else 0.0
        return row

    # D1/D2 predictions use season dummies: average over seasons for archetype
    season_pred_S, season_pred_phi, surv_curves = {}, {}, {}
    for (nm, ag, indc, partner, hreg) in archetypes:
        tv = trait_vec(ag, indc, hreg)
        base = np.zeros(len(C_traits))
        for j, c in enumerate(C_traits):
            base[j] = tv.get(c, 0.0)
        S_list, P_list = [], []
        for s in all_seasons:
            if s < 2:
                continue
            row = np.concatenate([base, np.zeros(len(C_struct))])
            row[len(base) + season_cols_full.index(f"season_{s}")] = 1.0
            row[len(trait_cols) + len(season_cols_full)] = 0.0        # week_2 = 0
            row[len(trait_cols) + len(season_cols_full) + 1:] = [0.0] * (len(week_d.columns) - 1)
            row[-1] = 0.20                                             # cum01 at week 3
            # (week_2 dummy + cum01 + season)
            S_list.append(float(r_model.predict(row.reshape(1, -1))[0]))
            P_list.append(float(gee.predict(row.reshape(1, -1))[0]))
        S_list, P_list = np.array(S_list), np.array(P_list)
        season_pred_S[nm] = float(S_list.mean())
        season_pred_phi[nm] = float(P_list.mean())
        # survival via D4 step-2 (zS=0, cum01=0.20, phi0 from D2 back-transformed)
        phi0 = float(P_list.mean())
        phi0_std = (phi0 - wk["phi_hat"].mean()) / wk["phi_hat"].std(ddof=0)
        curve = {}
        for w in range(1, 11):
            ss_list = []
            for s in all_seasons:
                if s < 2:
                    continue
                row2 = np.zeros(len(cols_step2))
                row2[cols_step2.index("const") if "const" in cols_step2 else 0] = 0.0
                Xt2 = np.row_stack([np.concatenate([[1.0], base * 0 + np.nan])] * 0)  # placeholder
                del Xt2
                feat = {c: 0.0 for c in cols_step2}
                feat.update(tv_anon := {})  # placeholder
                # map archetype into PHReg design (zS=0, cum01=0.20, phi_std, traits)
                tv2 = trait_vec(ag, indc, hreg)
                feat["zS"] = 0.0
                feat["cum01"] = 0.20
                feat["phi_hat_std"] = phi0_std
                feat["age_cs"] = tv2["age_cs"]
                for c in ind_d.columns:
                    v = c.replace("ind_", "").replace("_", " ")
                    feat[c] = tv2.get(c, 0.0)
                for c in home_d.columns:
                    key = "home_" + {"East-SE-Asia": "East_SE_Asia", "UK-Ireland": "UK_Ireland"}.get(
                        c.replace("home_", ""), c.replace("home_", ""))
                    feat[c] = tv2.get(key, 0.0)
                if f"season_{s}" in feat:
                    feat[f"season_{s}"] = 1.0
                Xp = np.array([1.0 if "const" in cols_step2 else 0.0] + [0.0] *
                              (len(cols_step2) - (1 if "const" in cols_step2 else 0)))
                # rebuild row in the exact order of cols_step2
                rowv = np.array([feat.get(c, 0.0) for c in cols_step2])
                Xrow = sm.add_constant(rowv.reshape(1, -1), has_constant="add") \
                    if "const" in cols_step2 else rowv.reshape(1, -1)
                lp = float((Xrow * r42.params.to_numpy()[None, :]).sum())
                ss_list.append(sigma(lp))
            curve[w] = float(np.mean(1 - np.array(ss_list))) if w > 0 else np.nan
        # cumulative survival
        surv = {}
        prod = 1.0
        for w in range(1, 11):
            prod *= (1.0 - np.array(list(curve.values()))[w - 1])
            surv[w] = float(prod)
        surv_curves[nm] = surv
    for nm in surv_curves:
        sc = surv_curves[nm]
        log(f"[archetype] {nm}: S_w3={season_pred_S[nm]:.2f}, phi_w3={season_pred_phi[nm]:.3f}, "
            f"surv(5 wks)={sc[5]:.3f}, surv(9 wks)={sc[9]:.3f}")

    # ================= effect table =============================================
    rows = []
    def add_rows(params, pvals, res, conf, channel):
        for nm, b in params.items():
            if nm == "const":
                continue
            pv = pvals.get(nm, np.nan)
            se = np.sqrt(float(conf.loc[nm, nm]) if hasattr(conf, "loc") else res.bse[nm] ** 2)
            rows.append({"channel": channel, "covariate": nm, "coef": float(b),
                         "se": float(se), "ci_low": float(b - 1.96 * se),
                         "ci_high": float(b + 1.96 * se), "p": float(pv)})

    try:
        conf1 = r1.cov_params()
    except Exception:
        conf1 = None
    add_rows(fe1, r1.pvalues, r1, conf1 if conf1 is not None else (r1.bse ** 2), "judge")
    add_rows(fe2, gee.pvalues if hasattr(gee, "pvalues") else {}, gee,
             gee.cov_params() if hasattr(gee, "cov_params") else gee.bse ** 2, "fan")
    add_rows(ols3.params, ols3.pvalues, ols3, ols3.cov_params(), "differential")
    covtab = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    # D4 table
    d4tab = pd.DataFrame({
        "covariate": list(r42.params.index),
        "coef_step2_excelphi": list(r42.params.to_numpy()),
    }).set_index("covariate")
    d4tab["coef_step1_no_phi"] = [r41.params.get(c, np.nan) for c in d4tab.index]
    d4tab["p_step2"] = [r42.pvalues.get(c, np.nan) for c in d4tab.index]
    # label 'no extra signal beyond the two scores'
    sig_lvl = 0.05
    no_extra = [(c, float(r41.pvalues[c]), float(r42.pvalues.get(c, np.nan)))
                for c in d4tab.index
                if r41.pvalues[c] < sig_lvl and (np.isnan(r42.pvalues.get(c, np.nan)) or r42.pvalues[c] >= sig_lvl)]
    log("[D4] traits losing significance after phi_hat: "
        + ", ".join([f"{c} (p1={a:.3g} -> p2={b:.3g})" for c, a, b in no_extra]) or "none")

    # ================= export ====================================================
    wk_export = wk[["row_id", "season", "week", "celebrity_name", "ballroom_partner",
                    "age", "ind_g", "home_g", "p_g", "status", "week_score_mean",
                    "cum01", "zS", "phi_hat", "var_phi", "phi_lo90", "phi_hi90",
                    "phi_tilde", "S_hat", "phi_tilde_hat", "R", "elim", "pre_week"]].copy()
    wk_export.to_csv(OUT / "model3_weekly_panel.csv", index=False)
    covtab.to_csv(OUT / "model3_covariate_effects.csv", index=False)
    d4tab.to_csv(OUT / "model3_survival_effects.csv")
    pd.DataFrame([{"archetype": nm, "pred_S_week3": season_pred_S[nm],
                   "pred_fan_share_week3": season_pred_phi[nm],
                   **{f"survival_week_{w}": surv_curves[nm][w] for w in range(1, 11)}}
                  for nm in season_pred_S]).to_csv(OUT / "model3_archetypes.csv", index=False)
    pd.DataFrame([{"group": g, "age_coef_judge": bb, "p_judge": pp, "age_coef_fan": bb2}
                  for g, (bb, pp, bb2) in sign_store.items()]).to_csv(
        OUT / "model3_loio_robustness.csv", index=False)

    # industry x differential heatmap data
    hm = wk.groupby("ind_g").agg(n_weeks=("R", "size"), mean_S=("S", "mean"),
                                 mean_phi=("phi_hat", "mean"),
                                 mean_R=("R", "mean")).reset_index().sort_values("mean_R")
    hm.to_csv(OUT / "model3_industry_summary.csv", index=False)
    hm2 = wk.groupby("p_g").agg(n_weeks=("R", "size"), mean_S=("S", "mean"),
                                mean_phi=("phi_hat", "mean"),
                                mean_R=("R", "mean"),
                                age_coef=("_x", "size")).reset_index()
    hm2 = wk.groupby("p_g").agg(n_weeks=("R", "size"), mean_S=("S", "mean"),
                                mean_phi=("phi_hat", "mean"), mean_R=("R", "mean")).reset_index()
    hm2.to_csv(OUT / "model3_partner_summary.csv", index=False)
    log(f"[export] weekly panel {len(wk_export)} rows, effects table {len(covtab)} rows")

    results = {
        "n_week_rows": int(len(wk)),
        "n_seasons": int(wk["season"].nunique()),
        "n_celebrities": int(wk["celebrity_name"].nunique()),
        "phi_hat_mean": float(wk["phi_hat"].mean()),
        "phi_hat_median": float(wk["phi_hat"].median()),
        "phi_hat_max": float(wk["phi_hat"].max()),
        "phi_lo90_median_width": float((wk["phi_hi90"] - wk["phi_lo90"]).median()),
        "m1_info": m1info,
        "D1_converged": bool(conv1),
        "D1_var_random": float(r1.cov_re.iloc[0, 0] if hasattr(r1.cov_re, "iloc") else r1.cov_re[0, 0]),
        "D1_resid_var": float(r1.scale),
        "D1_age_coef_per_sigma": float(age_b),
        "D1_age_effect_points_per_13y": float(age_b * AGE_SCALE),
        "D1_age_p": float(age_p),
        "D1_industry_partialR2": float(pr2_ind[0]),
        "D1_partner_partialR2": float(pr2_part[0]),
        "D1_industry_p": float(pr2_ind[1]),
        "D1_partner_p": float(pr2_part[1]),
        "D1_AR1_llf": float(r1a.llf), "D1_AR1_converged": bool(conv1a),
        "D1_LRT_p": lrt_p, "D1_LRT_note": r_ar_notes,
        "D1_key_coefs": {k: float(v) for k, v in fe1.items()
                         if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete", "ind_Singer",
                                  "ind_Reality_Star", "ind_Host", "ind_Actor_Actress",
                                  "ind_Singer_Songwriter", "home_UK_Ireland",
                                  "home_East_SE_Asia", "cum01"]},
        "D2_GEE_dep": float(gee.cov_struct.dep),
        "D2_age_coef": float(phi_age_b), "D2_age_p": None if np.isnan(phi_age_p) else float(phi_age_p),
        "D2_key_coefs": {k: float(v) for k, v in fe2.items()
                         if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete", "ind_Singer",
                                  "ind_Reality_Star", "ind_Host", "ind_Actor_Actress",
                                  "ind_Singer_Songwriter", "home_UK_Ireland",
                                  "home_East_SE_Asia"]},
        "D3_age_coef": float(r3_age), "D3_age_p": float(r3_age_p),
        "D3_key_coefs": {k: float(v) for k, v in ols3.params.items()
                         if k in ["age_cs", "ind_Athlete", "ind_Singer",
                                  "ind_Reality_Star", "ind_Host", "ind_Actor_Actress",
                                  "home_UK_Ireland", "home_East_SE_Asia"]},
        "D3_smp_mean_R": float(wk.loc[wk["ind_g"] == "Social Media Personality", "R"].mean())
        if (wk["ind_g"] == "Social Media Personality").any() else None,
        "D4_concordance_step1": float(conc1), "D4_concordance_step2": float(conc2),
        "D4_b_zS_step1": float(b_zS_1), "D4_b_zS_step2": float(b_zS_2),
        "D4_b_phi_step2": float(b_phi_2),
        "D4_b_phi_p": float(r42.pvalues["phi_hat_std"]),
        "D4_no_extra_traits": [{"covariate": c, "p_step1": a, "p_step2": b} for c, a, b in no_extra],
        "val_R2_judges": float(r2_judges), "val_spearman_fans": float(spear_fan),
        "val_survival_auc": float(auc_surv),
        "robust_flips": int(flipped), "robust_n_refits": int(len(sign_store)),
        "archetypes": {nm: {"S_w3": season_pred_S[nm], "phi_w3": season_pred_phi[nm],
                            "surv5": surv_curves[nm][5], "surv9": surv_curves[nm][9]}
                       for nm in season_pred_S},
        "n_elim_events": int(elim.sum()),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Model 1: Sub-Seasonal Survival Inversion of Latent Fan Votes (Bayesian + Belief Functions)
==========================================================================================
Recover latent fan-vote shares phi_iw for every DWTS couple in every week they danced.

Pipeline (fully deterministic; SEED fixed; no network access).

  Stage A  Discrete-time survival hazard (complementary log-log link) for the weekly
           chance of being the eliminated couple:
               h_iw = 1 - exp(-exp(a_week + x_iw' beta)),
           with week-index-stratum baselines a_w (couples cut at the season finale
           count as events; finalists are right-censored; withdrawers excluded).
           Covariates x: within-week judge percentile rank, low-judge dummy, season-
           to-date mean judge percentile, age (+ age^2), industry group dummies,
           pro-partner leave-one-out historical strength.

  Stage B  Empirical-Bayes Gaussian frailty u_i per celebrity-season = latent fan
           pressure. It enters the hazard multiplicatively: h = h0 * exp(u_i), so
           u < 0  <=> survives longer than judge scores predict <=> strong fan
           support; u > 0 <=> pushed out early <=> weak fan support.  The observed
           survival path updates  p(u_i | path) ∝ exp(ell_i(u_i)) N(u_i; 0, sigma^2)
           on a grid (per-couple path likelihood, reset at each couple); sigma^2 is
           re-estimated from the posterior (EM-style) to convergence.  Fan-vote
           weight ∝ exp(-tau * u).

  Stage C  Dempster-Shafer belief layer per (season, week): each judge j's scores
           give masses over couples
               m_j({i}) = q_w * softmax_i(gamma * s_i^j),   m_j(Theta) = 1 - q_w,
           where s_i^j is judge j's within-week score share and q_w = 1/(1 + relative
           IQR of the judge cells).  Masses combined with Dempster's rule; conflict
           K_w retained.  Bel({i}), Pl({i}) reported; share interval from belief
           functions:  lo_i = Bel_i/(Bel_i + sum_{j!=i} Pl_j),
                       hi_i = Pl_i/(Pl_i + sum_{j!=i} Bel_j).

  Stage D  Fan-vote point estimate   phi_iw ∝ Bel({i}) * exp(-tau * u_i),  normalized
           on the week simplex.  Uncertainty: (i) D-S share interval; (ii) a
           Beta(c*phi, c*(1-phi)) posterior with pseudo-ballot count
           c_iw = m0 * (1 - K_w)  (m0 = 250 assumed ballots) -> 90% credible band;
           (iii) simulated P(eliminated): phi ~ Dirichlet(c_w * phi), lowest c_w of
           n_w couples cut -> Monte-Carlo probability and its reliability/Brier/AUC.

  Stage E  Validation: top-1 / top-2 elimination-hit rates vs baselines (judge
           share, judge rank, Bel-only, hazard-only), Brier + AUC of P(eliminated),
           reliability curve, leave-one-season-out (LOSO) refits of Stage A.

Outputs (written next to this script): fanvote_estimates.csv, results.json, figures/.
Run:  python3 run.py
"""

import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats as sstats
from scipy.special import expit, logsumexp, softmax

import statsmodels.api as sm

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams["font.family"] = "serif"

SEED = 20260101
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SHARED = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(BASE, "..", "..", "01_modeling", "shared_data"))
FIGDIR = os.path.join(BASE, "figures")
os.makedirs(FIGDIR, exist_ok=True)

N_SIM = 4000                     # Dirichlet draws per week for elimination probabilities
GAMMA_GRID = [4.0, 6.0, 8.0, 10.0, 12.0, 14.0, 16.0, 20.0]
TAU_GRID = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5]       # frailty loading on phi (phi ∝ Bel * exp(-tau*u))
TAU = 1.0                        # pre-registered plan choice
M0_BALLOTS = 250.0               # pseudo-ballot count deflating with conflict: c = m0*(1-K)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- data
def load_data():
    wk = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(SHARED, "weekly_scores.csv"))
    con = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(SHARED, "contestants.csv"))
    pan = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(SHARED, "week_panel.csv"))
    return wk, con, pan


def build_features(wk, con):
    """Attach celebrity covariates + within-week features to the danced-week panel."""
    df = wk.copy()
    # celebrity-level covariates joined BY VALUE (row_id repeats once per danced week
    # in this long panel, so a merge would violate one-to-one and explode rows)
    celeb = con.set_index("row_id")
    for col in ["celebrity_age_during_season", "celebrity_industry", "n_danced_weeks"]:
        df[col] = df["row_id"].map(celeb[col])
    df["season"] = df["season"].astype(int)
    df = df.sort_values(["season", "row_id", "week"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    # within-week judge percentile rank: 1 = best judge score of that week
    ncoup = df.groupby(["season", "week"])["row_id"].transform("size")
    df["n_active"] = ncoup.astype(int)
    df["judge_pct"] = 1.0 - (df["week_rank_judges"] - 1) / ncoup.clip(lower=2)

    df["low_score"] = (df["judge_pct"] < 0.25).astype(float)

    # season-so-far cumulative mean of judge percentile (known at week w);
    # rows are ordered by (row_id, week) so cumcount is chronological per couple
    gsum = df.groupby("row_id")["judge_pct"].cumsum()
    gcnt = df.groupby("row_id")["judge_pct"].cumcount().add(1)
    df["cum_pct"] = gsum / gcnt

    # age standardized (across all contestants)
    age_mu = df["celebrity_age_during_season"].mean()
    age_sd = df["celebrity_age_during_season"].std()
    df["age_z"] = (df["celebrity_age_during_season"] - age_mu) / age_sd
    df["age_z2"] = df["age_z"] ** 2

    # industry groups (4 dummies vs 'Other' reference)
    def grp(x):
        if x == "Actor/Actress":
            return "Actor"
        if x == "Athlete":
            return "Athlete"
        if x == "TV Personality":
            return "TV"
        if x == "Singer/Rapper":
            return "Singer"
        return "Other"
    df["ind_group"] = df["celebrity_industry"].map(grp)

    # partner (pro) leave-one-out historical strength: shrunk mean danced weeks of
    # the pro's OTHER partners (temporal leak is modest and reported as a caveat)
    mu_alive = con["n_danced_weeks"].mean()
    stats = con.groupby("ballroom_partner")["n_danced_weeks"].agg(["sum", "count"])
    df["partner_n"] = df["ballroom_partner"].map(stats["count"]).astype(float)
    df["partner_sum"] = df["ballroom_partner"].map(stats["sum"]).astype(float)
    nu = 1.5
    df["partner_loo"] = (df["partner_sum"] - df["n_danced_weeks"] + nu * mu_alive) \
        / (df["partner_n"] - 1.0 + nu)
    df.loc[df["partner_n"] == 1, "partner_loo"] = mu_alive
    p_mu = df["partner_loo"].mean()
    p_sd = df["partner_loo"].std()
    df["partner_loo_z"] = (df["partner_loo"] - p_mu) / p_sd

    # response: 1 if this row IS the elimination event
    df["y_elim"] = ((df["status"] == "eliminated")
                    & (df["week"] == df["elim_week"])).astype(int)
    df["used_in_supervision"] = (df["status"] != "withdrew").astype(int)
    return df


# ------------------------------------------------------------- design matrix helpers
WEEK_DUMMIES = [f"wk{w}" for w in range(2, 12)]           # week 1 = reference
IND_DUMMIES = ["ind_Actor", "ind_Athlete", "ind_TV", "ind_Singer"]
BASE_COVS = ["judge_pct", "low_score", "cum_pct", "age_z", "age_z2"]
BASE_COVS += IND_DUMMIES + ["partner_loo_z"]


def make_X(df, cols=None):
    """Build the design matrix; if cols given, guarantee exactly those columns."""
    X = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    X["const"] = 1.0
    for c in BASE_COVS:
        if c.startswith("ind_"):
            X[c] = (df["ind_group"] == c[4:]).astype(float).to_numpy()
        else:
            X[c] = df[c].astype(float).to_numpy()
    for w_lab in WEEK_DUMMIES:
        wnum = int(w_lab[2:])
        X[w_lab] = (df["week"] == wnum).astype(float).to_numpy()
    if cols is None:
        # drop zero-variance columns (single-season subsets may lack some weeks)
        keep = [c for c in X.columns if c == "const" or X[c].std() > 1e-12]
        return X[keep]
    return X[cols]


def fit_glm_cloglog(df_train):
    Xtr = make_X(df_train)
    ytr = df_train["y_elim"].to_numpy(float)
    glm = sm.GLM(ytr, Xtr, family=sm.families.Binomial(link=sm.families.links.CLogLog()))
    res = glm.fit(maxiter=200)
    return res, Xtr.columns.tolist()


# ------------------------------------------------------- Stage B: EB Gaussian frailty
def frailty_posteriors(df, h_base, sigma, u_grid=None):
    """Posterior of u_i (one frailty per celebrity-season) given hazards h_base(u)
    with u added to the cloglog linear predictor. posterior ∝ exp(ell_i(u)) N(0,s^2),
    where ell_i is the couple's FULL observed path log-likelihood (smoothing)."""
    if u_grid is None:
        u_grid = np.linspace(-6.0, 6.0, 481)
    h_base = np.clip(np.asarray(h_base, float), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    lam = -np.log1p(-h_base)                     # cumulative hazard  lambda = -log(1-h)
    eta_base = np.log(lam + 1e-300)              # cloglog linear predictor
    z = eta_base[:, None] + u_grid[None, :]      # (n_week_rows, n_grid)
    h_u = 1.0 - np.exp(-np.exp(z))
    h_u = np.clip(h_u, 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    y = df["y_elim"].to_numpy(float)[:, None]
    loglik = y * np.log(h_u) + (1 - y) * np.log1p(-h_u)      # (n, U)

    # scatter into per-couple (trip) matrix so cumulative path likelihood RESETS
    # at every couple (bug avoided: a plain axis-0 cumsum bleeds across couples)
    couple, _ = pd.factorize(df["row_id"].to_numpy())
    n_c = int(couple.max()) + 1
    n = len(df)
    pos = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
    seen = np.zeros(n_c, dtype=int)
    for k in range(n):                           # rows arrive ordered by (row_id, week)
        pos[k] = seen[couple[k]]
        seen[couple[k]] += 1
    Wmax = int(pos.max()) + 1
    L = np.full((n_c, Wmax), np.nan)
    L[couple, pos] = loglik
    path = np.nancumsum(L, axis=1)               # leading NaN -> 0, so path = sum to week
    ell = path[couple, pos]                      # (n, U)

    logprior = -0.5 * (u_grid / sigma) ** 2
    a = ell + logprior[None, :]
    a -= a.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    post = np.exp(a)
    post /= post.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    u_mean = post @ u_grid
    u_var = np.maximum(post @ (u_grid ** 2) - u_mean ** 2, 1e-12)
    return u_mean, np.sqrt(u_var), ell, u_grid


def fit_frailty(df_sup, h_base, max_iter=10, tol=1e-3):
    """EM-style loop: posterior mean of u, then variance update of sigma^2."""
    sigma = 1.0
    u_mean = np.zeros(len(df_sup))
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        u_mean, u_sd, _, _ = frailty_posteriors(df_sup, h_base, sigma)
        sigma_new = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(u_mean ** 2 + u_sd ** 2)))
        if abs(sigma_new - sigma) < tol:
            sigma = sigma_new
            break
        sigma = sigma_new
    return u_mean, u_sd, sigma


# --------------------------------------------------- Stage C: Dempster-Shafer beliefs
def dempster_combine(m1, m2):
    """m1, m2: dict{frozenset: mass}. Returns normalized combination and conflict K."""
    out = {}
    K = 0.0
    for A, a in m1.items():
        for B, b in m2.items():
            C = A & B
            if len(C) == 0:
                K += a * b
            else:
                out[C] = out.get(C, 0.0) + a * b
    tot = 1.0 - K
    return {k: v / tot for k, v in out.items() if v > 1e-15}, K


def ds_week(shares, q_w, gamma):
    """shares: (n_couples, n_judges) per-judge score shares within the week.
    Returns Bel, Pl, K for the week."""
    n, nj = shares.shape
    m = {frozenset(range(n)): 1.0}
    K_prev = 0.0
    for j in range(nj):
        logits = gamma * shares[:, j]
        p = softmax(logits - logits.max())
        mj = {frozenset([i]): q_w * float(p[i]) for i in range(n)}
        mj[frozenset(range(n))] = 1.0 - q_w
        m, K_step = dempster_combine(m, mj)
        K_prev = 1.0 - (1.0 - K_prev) * (1.0 - K_step)
    universe = frozenset(range(n))
    bel = np.array([m.get(frozenset([i]), 0.0) for i in range(n)])
    pl = bel + m.get(universe, 0.0)
    return bel, np.clip(pl, 0.0, 1.0), K_prev


def compute_all_beliefs(df, gamma):
    """Bel / Pl / K for every danced-week row (grouped by season, week)."""
    n = len(df)
    bel = np.zeros(n)
    pl = np.zeros(n)
    Kt = np.zeros(n)
    jcol = ["judge1", "judge2", "judge3", "judge4"]
    for (s, w), g in df.groupby(["season", "week"], sort=True):
        idx = g.index.to_numpy()
        cells = g[jcol].to_numpy(float)
        # per-judge relative shares (encoding-invariant across aggregate weeks)
        colsum = cells.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
        colsum[colsum == 0] = 1.0
        shares = np.nan_to_num(cells / colsum)
        # relative judge disagreement: mean over couples of IQR/mean of the cells
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            dif = np.nan_to_num(np.nanpercentile(cells, 75, axis=1)
                                - np.nanpercentile(cells, 25, axis=1))
            denom = np.nan_to_num(np.nanmean(cells, axis=1), nan=1.0)
            rel_iqr = float(np.mean(dif / np.maximum(denom, 1e-9)))
        q_w = 1.0 / (1.0 + rel_iqr)              # 0..1, shrinks masses when judges disagree
        b, p, K = ds_week(shares, q_w, gamma)
        bel[idx] = b
        pl[idx] = p
        Kt[idx] = K
    return bel, pl, Kt


def ds_share_interval(bel, pl):
    """Belief-function interval for a multinomial share:
    lo_i = Bel_i / (Bel_i + sum_{j!=i} Pl_j), hi_i = Pl_i / (Pl_i + sum_{j!=i} Bel_j)."""
    n = len(bel)
    sum_pl = pl.sum()
    sum_bel = bel.sum()
    lo = bel / (bel + (sum_pl - pl))
    hi = pl / (pl + (sum_bel - bel))
    return lo, hi


# ----------------------------------------------------------- validation helper metrics
def _week_share_normalize(vals, df):
    """Normalize a positive weight vector to shares *within each (season, week)*.
    Pure-numpy accumulation to avoid pandas transform-alignment pitfalls."""
    key = (df["season"].to_numpy() * 1000 + df["week"].to_numpy())
    order = np.argsort(key, kind="stable")
    sk = key[order]
    sv = np.asarray(vals, float)[order]
    starts = np.r_[0, np.where(np.diff(sk) != 0)[0] + 1]
    ends = np.r_[starts[1:], len(sk)]
    out = np.empty_like(sv)
    for a, b in zip(starts, ends):
        out[a:b] = sv[a:b] / sv[a:b].sum()
    res = np.empty_like(out)
    res[order] = out
    return res


def top1_hits(phi, df):
    """Fraction of elimination events whose couple has the MINIMUM phi in its week
    (= 'fan-vote lowest -> eliminated' rule)."""
    tmp = pd.DataFrame({"phi": np.asarray(phi, float), "y": df["y_elim"].to_numpy(),
                        "k": list(zip(df["season"], df["week"]))})
    tmp["wkmin"] = tmp.groupby("k")["phi"].transform("min")
    ok = tmp[(tmp.y == 1) & (tmp.phi <= tmp.wkmin + 1e-12)]
    return len(ok) / int(tmp.y.sum())


def top2_hits(phi, df):
    """Fraction of events whose couple has one of the 2 lowest phi in its week."""
    tmp = pd.DataFrame({"phi": np.asarray(phi, float), "y": df["y_elim"].to_numpy(),
                        "k": list(zip(df["season"], df["week"]))})
    tmp["rk"] = tmp.groupby("k")["phi"].rank(method="first")
    ok = tmp[(tmp.y == 1) & (tmp.rk <= 2)]
    return len(ok) / int(tmp.y.sum())


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------ main pipeline
def main():
    wk, con, pan = load_data()
    df = build_features(wk, con)
    n_rows_total = len(df)
    # withdrew couples excluded from all elimination supervision; keep rows for export
    n_events = int(df["y_elim"].sum())
    seasons = sorted(df["season"].unique())
    df_sup = df[df["used_in_supervision"] == 1].copy()
    df_sup = df_sup.sort_values(["row_id", "week"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)
    print(f"[load] danced-week rows: {n_rows_total} | supervision rows: {len(df_sup)} "
          f"| elimination events: {n_events} | seasons: {len(seasons)}")

    # ---------------- Stage A: cloglog GLM
    res, cols_used = fit_glm_cloglog(df_sup)
    df_sup["hazard_week"] = np.asarray(res.predict(make_X(df_sup, cols_used)), float)
    aic = float(res.aic)
    coefs = {c: float(b) for c, b in zip(cols_used, res.params)}
    ses = {c: float(b) for c, b in zip(cols_used, res.bse)}
    print("[glm] converged:", res.converged, "| AIC:", round(aic, 1))
    for c in ["judge_pct", "low_score", "cum_pct", "age_z", "age_z2",
              "ind_Actor", "ind_Athlete", "ind_TV", "ind_Singer", "partner_loo_z"]:
        if c in coefs:
            print(f"    {c:>16s}: beta={coefs[c]:+.3f} (se {ses[c]:.3f})")
    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score as auc_score
    auc_stage1 = float(auc_score(df_sup["y_elim"], df_sup["hazard_week"]))

    # week-stratum baselines at zero covariates
    base_haz = {}
    for w in range(1, 12):
        eta = coefs.get("const", 0.0) + (coefs.get(f"wk{w}", 0.0) if w >= 2 else 0.0)
        base_haz[w] = float(1.0 - np.exp(-np.exp(eta)))
    print("[glm] week-stratum baseline hazards (at zero covariates):")
    for w in range(1, 8):
        print(f"    week {w}: {base_haz[w]:.3f}")

    # ---------------- Stage B: EB frailty (latent fan pressure, u<0 = fan favorite)
    u_mean, u_sd, sigma_u = fit_frailty(df_sup, df_sup["hazard_week"].to_numpy(float))
    df_sup["fan_frailty_u"] = u_mean
    df_sup["fan_frailty_sd"] = u_sd
    corr_u_nweeks = float(np.corrcoef(df_sup["fan_frailty_u"],
                                      df_sup["n_danced_weeks"])[0, 1])
    corr_u_jpct = float(np.corrcoef(df_sup["fan_frailty_u"], df_sup["judge_pct"])[0, 1])
    print(f"[frailty] sigma_u = {sigma_u:.3f} | u range [{u_mean.min():+.2f}, {u_mean.max():+.2f}] "
          f"| corr(u, n_danced_weeks) = {corr_u_nweeks:+.3f} "
          f"| corr(u, judge_pct) = {corr_u_jpct:+.3f}")

    # ---------------- Stage C: D-S beliefs + calibrated gamma (order-invariant; picks scale)
    gamma_pick, best_hit = GAMMA_GRID[-1], -1.0
    gamma_report = {}
    for g in GAMMA_GRID:
        bel_g, _, _ = compute_all_beliefs(df_sup, g)
        hit = top1_hits(bel_g, df_sup)
        gamma_report[g] = round(float(hit), 4)
        if hit >= best_hit:                      # >= keeps the LARGEST gamma on ties
            best_hit, gamma_pick = hit, g
    print(f"[ds] gamma grid top-1 hit rates: {gamma_report} -> gamma={gamma_pick}")
    bel, pl, Kt = compute_all_beliefs(df_sup, gamma_pick)
    df_sup["bel"], df_sup["plaus"], df_sup["ds_conflict_K"] = bel, pl, Kt

    # ---------------- Stage D: phi_iw ∝ Bel * exp(-tau * u), normalized per week
    phi_store, hit_store, hit2_store = {}, {}, {}
    for tau in TAU_GRID:
        w_raw = bel * np.exp(-tau * u_mean)
        phi = _week_share_normalize(w_raw, df_sup)
        phi_store[tau], hit_store[tau], hit2_store[tau] = phi, top1_hits(phi, df_sup), top2_hits(phi, df_sup)
        print(f"[phi] tau={tau}: top-1 hit {hit_store[tau]:.3f}, top-2 hit {hit2_store[tau]:.3f}")
    phi_hat = phi_store[TAU]
    df_sup["phi_hat"] = phi_hat
    df_sup["phi_rank"] = df_sup.groupby(["season", "week"])["phi_hat"].rank(method="average").astype(int)

    # ---------------- validation: elimination-reproduction hits vs baselines
    bs_share = top1_hits(df_sup["judge_share"].to_numpy(), df_sup)     # lowest judge share out
    bs_rank = top1_hits(-df_sup["week_rank_judges"].to_numpy(), df_sup)  # highest rank number out
    bs_bel = top1_hits(bel, df_sup)
    cumhaz = -np.log1p(-df_sup["hazard_week"].clip(1e-9, 1 - 1e-9))
    bs_haz = top1_hits(-cumhaz.to_numpy(), df_sup)                    # highest hazard out
    bs_share2 = top2_hits(df_sup["judge_share"].to_numpy(), df_sup)
    bs_bel2 = top2_hits(bel, df_sup)
    print(f"[validation] top-1 hit: phi {hit_store[TAU]:.3f} | Bel-only {bs_bel:.3f} | "
          f"judge-share {bs_share:.3f} | judge-rank {bs_rank:.3f} | hazard {bs_haz:.3f}")
    print(f"[validation] top-2 hit: phi {hit2_store[TAU]:.3f} | Bel-only {bs_bel2:.3f} | "
          f"judge-share {bs_share2:.3f}")

    # ---------------- uncertainty: D-S share interval + moment-matched Beta band
    ds_lo, ds_hi = ds_share_interval(bel, pl)
    c_pseudo = M0_BALLOTS * (1.0 - Kt)                    # pseudo-ballots, conflict-deflated
    c_pseudo = np.clip(c_pseudo, 2.0, None)
    a_post = c_pseudo * phi_hat
    b_post = c_pseudo * (1.0 - phi_hat)
    beta_lo = sstats.beta.ppf(0.05, a_post, b_post)
    beta_hi = sstats.beta.ppf(0.95, a_post, b_post)
    width90 = beta_hi - beta_lo
    rel_iqr_all = None
    print(f"[interval] median 90% width {np.median(width90):.4f} | "
          f"corr(width, K) = {np.corrcoef(width90, Kt)[0, 1]:+.3f}")

    # ---------------- simulated P(eliminated) via Dirichlet(c_w * phi) draws
    p_elim = np.zeros(len(df_sup))
    yvec = df_sup["y_elim"].to_numpy()
    grid_weeks = sorted(set(zip(df_sup["season"], df_sup["week"])))
    draws_by_week = {}
    for (s, w) in grid_weeks:
        m = (df_sup["season"].to_numpy() == s) & (df_sup["week"].to_numpy() == w)
        idx = np.where(m)[0]
        konf = float(Kt[idx].mean())
        conc = max(M0_BALLOTS * (1.0 - konf), 2.0)
        alpha_vec = np.maximum(conc * phi_hat[idx], 1e-6)
        draws = rng.dirichlet(alpha_vec, size=N_SIM)      # (N_SIM, n_week) fan shares
        nelim_rows = pan[(pan.season == s) & (pan.week == w)]
        k_cut = int(nelim_rows["n_eliminated_this_week"].iloc[0]) if len(nelim_rows) else 0
        bottom = np.argsort(draws, axis=1)[:, :k_cut]     # lowest shares are cut
        mask = np.zeros(draws.shape, dtype=bool)
        np.put_along_axis(mask, bottom, True, axis=1)
        p_elim[idx] = mask.mean(axis=0)
        draws_by_week[(s, w)] = None                      # (not stored; memory)
    df_sup["p_elim_sim"] = p_elim

    brier_all = float(np.mean((p_elim - yvec) ** 2))
    ev = yvec == 1
    brier_events = float(np.mean((p_elim[ev] - 1.0) ** 2))
    auc_pelim = float(auc_score(yvec, p_elim))
    # reliability deciles (equal-count bins)
    q10 = np.quantile(p_elim, np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9))
    bins = np.searchsorted(q10, p_elim, side="right")
    rel_pred, rel_obs = [], []
    for b in range(10):
        msk = bins == b
        if msk.sum() >= 5:
            rel_pred.append(float(p_elim[msk].mean()))
            rel_obs.append(float(yvec[msk].mean()))
    print(f"[sim] Brier(all)={brier_all:.3f} | Brier(events)={brier_events:.3f} | "
          f"AUC(P_elim)={auc_pelim:.3f} | mean P(elim)={p_elim.mean():.3f}")

    # ---------------- LOSO by season (Stage-A refit; phi recomputed with held-out hazard)
    loso_auc, loso_hits, loso_top2 = [], [], []
    for s in seasons:
        tr = df_sup[df_sup["season"] != s]
        te = df_sup[df_sup["season"] == s]
        if tr["y_elim"].sum() == 0 or len(te) == 0 or te["y_elim"].sum() == 0:
            continue
        res_l, cols_l = fit_glm_cloglog(tr)
        h_te = np.asarray(res_l.predict(make_X(te, cols_l)), float)
        loso_auc.append(float(auc_score(te["y_elim"], h_te)))
        u_te, _, _, _ = frailty_posteriors(te, h_te, sigma_u)
        bel_te = te["bel"].to_numpy()
        phi_te = _week_share_normalize(bel_te * np.exp(-TAU * u_te), te)
        loso_hits.append(top1_hits(phi_te, te))
        loso_top2.append(top2_hits(phi_te, te))
    loso_auc_m = float(np.mean(loso_auc))
    loso_h1_m = float(np.mean(loso_hits))
    loso_h2_m = float(np.mean(loso_top2))
    print(f"[loso] AUC {loso_auc_m:.3f} (drop {auc_stage1 - loso_auc_m:+.3f} pp) | "
          f"top-1 {loso_h1_m:.3f} (drop {hit_store[TAU] - loso_h1_m:+.3f}) | "
          f"top-2 {loso_h2_m:.3f} (drop {hit2_store[TAU] - loso_h2_m:+.3f}) | "
          f"n_seasons={len(loso_auc)}")

    # ---------------- iconic contestants
    iconic = [("Bobby Bones", 27), ("Jerry Rice", 2), ("Bristol Palin", 11),
              ("Joey Graziadei", 34)]
    iconic_rows = {}
    for nm, s in iconic:
        g = df_sup[(df_sup.celebrity_name == nm) & (df_sup.season == s)].sort_values("week")
        if len(g) == 0:
            print(f"[warn] iconic not found: {nm} S{s}")
            continue
        iconic_rows[nm] = {
            "season": int(s), "weeks": g["week"].astype(int).tolist(),
            "phi": g["phi_hat"].round(4).tolist(),
            "lo": np.round(beta_lo[g.index.to_numpy()], 4).tolist(),
            "hi": np.round(beta_hi[g.index.to_numpy()], 4).tolist(),
            "judge_pct": g["judge_pct"].round(3).tolist(),
            "u": g["fan_frailty_u"].round(3).tolist(),
            "K": g["ds_conflict_K"].round(3).tolist(),
            "y": g["y_elim"].astype(int).tolist(),
        }
        print(f"[iconic] {nm} S{s}: u={g['fan_frailty_u'].iloc[0]:+.2f} "
              f"phi_w={np.round(g['phi_hat'].to_numpy(), 3).tolist()} "
              f"judge_pct={np.round(g['judge_pct'].to_numpy(), 2).tolist()}")

    # ---------------- export fanvote_estimates.csv (ALL danced-week rows incl. withdrew)
    out = df.copy()
    fitted_cols = ["hazard_week", "fan_frailty_u", "fan_frailty_sd", "bel", "plaus",
                   "ds_conflict_K", "ds_share_lo", "ds_share_hi", "phi_hat", "phi_rank",
                   "beta_lo90", "beta_hi90", "pseudo_count_c", "p_elim_sim"]
    df_sup["ds_share_lo"] = ds_lo
    df_sup["ds_share_hi"] = ds_hi
    df_sup["beta_lo90"] = beta_lo
    df_sup["beta_hi90"] = beta_hi
    df_sup["pseudo_count_c"] = c_pseudo
    for c in fitted_cols:
        out[c] = np.nan
    out.loc[df_sup.index, fitted_cols] = df_sup[fitted_cols]
    out["used_in_supervision"] = out["used_in_supervision"].astype(int)

    export = out[["row_id", "season", "week", "celebrity_name", "ballroom_partner",
                  "celebrity_age_during_season", "celebrity_industry",
                  "n_active", "n_judges_scored", "scoring_type",
                  "week_score_mean", "judge_share", "week_rank_judges", "judge_pct",
                  "bel", "plaus", "ds_conflict_K", "ds_share_lo", "ds_share_hi",
                  "phi_hat", "phi_rank", "beta_lo90", "beta_hi90", "pseudo_count_c",
                  "hazard_week", "fan_frailty_u", "fan_frailty_sd",
                  "p_elim_sim", "y_elim", "used_in_supervision",
                  "status", "placement"]].copy()
    export = export.sort_values(["season", "week", "row_id"], kind="mergesort")
    csv_path = os.path.join(BASE, "fanvote_estimates.csv")
    export.to_csv(csv_path, index=False, float_format="%.6f")
    ph = export.dropna(subset=["phi_hat"])
    ww = ph.groupby(["season", "week"])["phi_hat"].sum()
    assert np.allclose(ww, 1.0, atol=1e-4), "phi must sum to 1 within each week"
    assert (ph.phi_hat > 0).all()
    print(f"[export] {csv_path} rows={len(export)} | phi sums to 1 in all {len(ww)} weeks; all phi > 0")

    # ---------------- results.json
    results = {
        "seed": SEED,
        "counts": {
            "danced_week_rows": int(n_rows_total),
            "supervision_rows": int(len(df_sup)),
            "elimination_events": int(n_events),
            "censored_finalists": int((df_sup["y_elim"] == 0).groupby(
                df_sup["row_id"]).all().sum()),   # couples never eliminated in-sample
            "seasons": int(len(seasons)),
            "withdrew_excluded": int((df["status"] == "withdrew").sum()),
            "aggregate_weeks": int((pan.scoring_type == "aggregate").sum()),
        },
        "hazard_glm": {
            "aic": aic, "converged": bool(res.converged),
            "coefficients": coefs, "std_errors": ses,
            "baseline_hazard_by_week": base_haz,
            "auc_stage1": auc_stage1,
        },
        "frailty": {
            "sigma_u": sigma_u,
            "corr_u_ndancedweeks": corr_u_nweeks,
            "corr_u_judge_pct": corr_u_jpct,
            "u_min": float(u_mean.min()), "u_max": float(u_mean.max()),
        },
        "belief_layer": {
            "gamma_grid_top1hit": {str(k): v for k, v in gamma_report.items()},
            "gamma_selected": gamma_pick,
            "K_median": float(np.median(Kt)),
            "K_p90": float(np.quantile(Kt, 0.9)),
            "K_max": float(Kt.max()),
        },
